notes.title: News on Project Space Hunter
notes.notes:
Hello Everybody,
Project Space Hunter is still alive. We've been working on this Game for a very long time now, but did anything change? Yes, many things. First of all Project Space Hunter (PSH) is now called Project Space Hunter - Fear in Space. But why "Fear in Space"? PSH now isnt an Online Sci-Fi Multiplayer Shooter anymore but instead a Singleplayer Sci-Fi Horror shooter with a Story. Sounds a bit weird but trust me on this one. We may launch a Beta Version of the Game with the first 2 Chapter for you to test, but we'll notify you guys when its time. And most importantly the full Game will either launch in Fall 2024 or Spring 2025 (depending on the amount of bugs you'll find in the beta ;) ). Hope you're exited as well.
We also may post news on the game on our Social Media [url=https://www.instagram.com/gd_bbn/]Instagram[/url]
